smells: excessive mocks reproduce private implementation details
fixed sleep calls hide asynchronous races
shared data and cleanup across parallel workers
assertions check only status codes and snapshots
history: offline mobile cases intermittently pass before queued work is durable
retry tests sometimes create duplicate operations
tenant tests share one identity and never cross boundaries
migration tests verify only command exit status
accessibility checks are an automated rule scan only

governing_behaviors.risk: A web refresh after acknowledgement can lose an accepted order.
governing_behaviors.invariant: One acknowledged order remains observable after reload.

governing_behaviors.risk: A timeout and retry can charge or persist the same operation twice.
governing_behaviors.invariant: One idempotency key yields one authoritative operation and result.

governing_behaviors.risk: Offline work can show false success, replay out of order, or overwrite a conflict after reconnect.
governing_behaviors.invariant: Pending, synced, conflicted, and failed states remain truthful through process death and reconnect.

governing_behaviors.risk: Tenant A can read or mutate Tenant B through a direct identifier, list, cache, or background job.
governing_behaviors.invariant: Every authoritative path denies cross-tenant access in both directions without side effects.

governing_behaviors.risk: A migration drops legacy values or reports success after partial failure.
governing_behaviors.invariant: Supported old data survives forward migration and failed work rolls back or recovers without false completion.

governing_behaviors.risk: Keyboard or screen-reader users cannot identify an error or recover focus.
governing_behaviors.invariant: Approved names, roles, focus order, error announcement, and recovery remain operable.

governing_behaviors.risk: A simulator-only pass misses physical-device process, storage, notification, or accessibility-service behavior.
governing_behaviors.invariant: Claims remain limited to the platform and device evidence actually observed.
